traits.stem_form.note: Flora of North America vol. 4 (read on eFloras 2026-10-19), Astrophytum: Astrophytum: stem unsegmented, dark green or gray-green, hemispheric or depressed-spheric, (2.5-)6-15 × 6-10(-20) cm, speckled by numerous tufts of dense, whitish hairs less than 0.5 mm; ribs 8-10, broad and nearly flat or rounded; areoles 6-9 mm apart, circular; spines absent. Flowers near the stem apex, funnelform; ovary sparsely to densely scaly, the axils long hairy with arachnoid trichomes. Fruits sparsely to densely scaly, the axils of the scales long woolly, spineless; floral remnant persistent.
